nodes.description: private mapping(address=>uint) playerKey; accumulates a pseudo-random key per contract address and is reset when a game finishes (used as randomness entropy source)
public mapping(address=>uint) playerCount; tracks how many players have joined the current game for the contract address
public mapping(address=>uint) currentGame; monotonically increasing game round counter, used to invalidate old registrations
public mapping(address=>uint) currentPlayersRequired; number of players needed to close the round (initialized to 100)
private mapping(address=>uint) playerRegistrationStatus; stores the game id in which an address last registered
private mapping(address=>uint) playerNumber; the slot number assigned to a player in the current round
private mapping(uint=>address) numberToAddress; maps slot numbers (1..100) to players, used to resolve the winning address
public uint currentBet; fixed entry price, initially 0.005 ether, changeable by the owner
public address contractAddress; set to this, used as the mapping key for global game state
public address owner; privileged address that can change the bet and transfer ownership
public address lastWinner; address that won the most recent completed round
public function transferOwnership(address newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; reassigns the owner and emits OwnershipTransferred
public function changeBet(uint _newBet) guarded by noPendingBets and onlyOwner; overwrites currentBet with an arbitrary value
constructor AllForOne(); initializes contractAddress, game round 1, required players 100, currentBet and sets owner/lastWinner to msg.sender
public view canBet(); returns registration status of msg.sender, playerCount and lastWinner snapshots
public payable placeBet(uint _input) guarded by betCondition; registers a player, accumulates a timestamp-based key and pays out 99%/1% when the round is full
modifier onlyOwner(); require(msg.sender == owner) access gate
modifier noPendingBets(); require(playerCount[contractAddress] == 0) state gate
modifier betCondition(uint _input); validates registration freshness, round capacity, exact msg.value == currentBet and _input > 0
caller-controlled address used as owner, as mapping key and as the account being validated
now/block.timestamp, used as entropy for the player key and the winning number as well as directly inside placeBet
owner = msg.sender inside the constructor; ownership is granted to the deployer/caller without any guard
_winningAddress.transfer(currentBet * 99); external ether transfer to an attacker-selectable address while round/game state is still being mutated
owner.transfer(currentBet * 1); external ether transfer of the 1% house fee
keccak256(_input + now) / now and keccak256(now + playerKey[contractAddress]) % 100 + 1; weak, manipulable on-chain randomness derived from block.timestamp
playerKey[contractAddress] += _playerKey; unguarded accumulation of an attacker-influenced key (overflow/underflow class arithmetic)
currentBet * 99 and currentBet * 1; unchecked multiplication determining the payout amounts
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership; becomes the new privileged owner
_newBet parameter of changeBet; arbitrary new value written into currentBet
_input parameter of placeBet/betCondition; caller-chosen value mixed into the randomness and validated by betCondition
_status local in canBet; flag derived from playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] comparison
_playerCount local in canBet; cached playerCount[contractAddress]
_lastWinner local in canBet; cached lastWinner address
_playerKey local in placeBet; result of uint(keccak256(_input + now)) / now added to playerKey[contractAddress]
_winningNumber local in placeBet; uint(keccak256(now + playerKey[contractAddress])) % 100 + 1 used to pick the winner slot
_winningAddress local in placeBet; numberToAddress[_winningNumber], the address receiving the 99% payout

normalization_plan.reason: the newOwner parameter only exists to feed transferOwnership and should be collapsed into that function node
the _newBet parameter only exists to feed changeBet's assignment to currentBet
the _input parameter is consumed by placeBet (through betCondition) and can be folded into the function node
the _status local is a temporary within canBet and is merged back into that function
the _playerCount local is a cached value local to canBet and merges into that function
the _lastWinner local is a cached value local to canBet and merges into that function
_playerKey is produced solely to be accumulated into playerKey[contractAddress] and merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation
_winningNumber is produced solely by the timestamp-based randomness expression and merges into that unsafe operation
_winningAddress is derived only to be the receiver of the external payout transfer and merges into that unsafe call operation
